steps.prompt: Sit the person upright and lean slightly forward (not backward). Tilting back causes blood to run down the throat.
Pinch the soft part of the nose firmly just below the bony bridge. Hold continuously for 10 to 15 minutes. Do not release early to check.
After 10–15 minutes, has the bleeding stopped?
Re-apply firm pinch pressure for another 10–15 minutes. If bleeding continues after a total of 30 minutes, or if blood is very heavy, call emergency services.
Did the bleed follow a head injury, or is the person on blood-thinning medication?
A nosebleed after a head injury may indicate a skull fracture. Seek medical care promptly. Do not pack the nose.
Once stopped, advise the person not to blow their nose, pick at it, or stoop forward for several hours. Seek care if it restarts.
